source_text: Vocavit Iesus Rubenitas Gadditas dimidiam Manasse — laudavit oboedientiam. Revertimini ad tabernacula cum divitiis. Fraterna pax post commune bellum.
pass_a_gloss: Called Jesus Reubenites Gadites half Manasseh — he-praised obedience. Return unto tents with riches. Brotherly peace after common war.
pass_b_english: [[Jesus calls Reubenites, Gadites, half-Manasseh — praises their obedience >> Bible:Joshua 22:1-6]]. Return to your tents with riches. Brotherly peace after shared war.
